About Me

Big ambitions, deeper roots

A computer engineer turned business leader, rooted in Ahmedabad.

As General Manager at Mavlers, a digital marketing agency, I lead teams, strategy and operations, and I have also founded a side venture of my own. I never stopped learning after my degree, and I read widely about business, entrepreneurship and markets.

I am ambitious, disciplined and competitive, yet grounded by family values. I value honesty, respect and warmth, and I would love a partnership where two people grow both as individuals and together.
